title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 070
review_goal: Differentiate laptop, list check, and magic variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Laptop screen frame above one curved lower base line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a laptop with a curved lower base under the open screen frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the straight base laptop when the platform should stay flat and level.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot bows the lower laptop base into a curved platform under the screen.

items.depicts_observation: Three left check marks aligned beside three horizontal list bars
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a checklist with check marks aligned to the left of text bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the square list checks when each row should begin with a square box.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot pairs three check marks on the left with three matching horizontal bars.

items.depicts_observation: Two square check boxes aligned left beside four horizontal list bars
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a checklist using square boxes beside horizontal list bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the three check mark list when the left side should show check marks instead of boxes.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot swaps the check marks for square boxes and varies the bar lengths on the right.

items.depicts_observation: Star outline with one diagonal wand line crossing the lower right edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a magic star outline crossed by one wand line.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the spark wand when the main star shape should break into short sparkle rays.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a large star outline with one wand line leaning across the lower right.

items.depicts_observation: Sparkle burst with short rays above one diagonal wand line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a wand line with a burst of short sparkle rays at the top.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the star wand when the sparkle should remain a burst rather than a full star outline.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the star outline with short sparkle rays radiating above the wand.
